segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for 42 seats and the services line so we can get you set for a May 20 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. I reviewed it this morning. The seat count is right, 38 standard users and 4 admins. I just need to confirm the invoice timing and the renewal date.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. The first invoice would go out on signature, net 30, for $28,560 for the annual subscription. The implementation package is $4,800, billed at kickoff, also net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, and the term runs through May 19 next year, right? Our finance team doesn't want it landing mid-month if we can avoid it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right now it's May 20 through May 19. If you prefer a month-end renewal, I can have deal desk prorate the first term through May 31 next year. It would add about $890 to the first-year total.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let's keep it as written for now. May 19 is fine. On implementation, is that three weeks or four weeks?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: The plan is four weeks. Week one is kickoff and data mapping, weeks two and three are configuration and testing, and week four is admin training and go-live support. We'd need your export file by April 22 to stay on track.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should work. I can get our operations manager to own the export. For contract terms, legal only asked about the auto-renewal notice period.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It's 60 days prior to renewal. I can point that out in the order form when I send the clean copy. No change needed unless your legal team wants different language.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, 60 days is okay. Send the clean copy and the security packet again, and I'll route it for signature today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the order form, security packet, and the implementation checklist in one email. If it's signed by Friday, we can hold the May 20 go-live slot.
